package com.example import scala.collection.mutable /** A demo. */ object Demo extends App { val name: String = "pier" val count: Int = 42 val ratio: Double = 1.5e-3 val sym: Symbol = 'hello val raw = s"name=$name count=$count" val multi = """line1 line2""" def greet(who: String): Unit = { println(s"hello, $who") } case class Point(x: Int, y: Int) trait Greet { def greet(): Unit } if (count > 0 && name.nonEmpty) greet(name) }
